global.title: The emerging space economy brings opportunity and legal risks for business
global.summary: Private companies now design, launch, own and operate space assets on a scale and pace that was unthinkable a decade ago. Even where companies are not directly involved in the space economy, some portion of their business likely depends on these recent developments. Updated satellite imagery feeds precision agriculture, insurance underwriting and environmental compliance programs. GPS timing signals synchronize financial markets in nanoseconds. items.title: The missing piece of America's supersonic comeback could also enable inland spaceports
items.summary: Two recent FAA actions could reshape how the United States approaches high-speed aviation and spaceflight. In July, the FAA announced a rulemaking effort to allow supersonic overland flight, implementing Executive Order 14304. Then, in August, the FAA issued a request for information toward implementing Executive Order 14369, which calls for the development of new U.S. spaceports, including “priority airspace” for launch and reentry operations.
